card.fact_statement: The government of Spain approved Royal Decree-Law 7/2025 as a response to the 2025 Iberian Peninsula blackout.
card.source_span: The government of Spain approved Royal Decree-Law 7/2025 on 24 June 2025 as a response to the blackout
